dedupe_keys.name: arcep j alerte l arcep annual statistics of user reports

description: J'alerte l'Arcep is the platform where users in France report problems with mobile, internet, postal, cloud and data-intermediation providers, and this dataset gives Arcep's annual statistical review of those reports. It counts reports by sector, operator and type of problem, such as coverage and network quality, faults and repair delays, fibre connection problems, billing and contract disputes, from reports that Arcep uses to target its regulation. Coverage: France, annual, for 2020 to 2025. Format and access: an annual ZIP of tables and the PDF review (about 8 MB) on data.gouv.fr; free under the Licence Ouverte 2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: reports are voluntary and not verified; counts reflect awareness of the platform as well as problems. Simulation uses: crowdsourced public reports of service problems for service performance baselines and for checking how faults are experienced by users in resilience studies. Related records: the Arcep FTTH quality indicators and unavailable mobile sites give operator-side measures.
